$comment: Shot list for the portfolio. See screenshots/README.md. Viewports: desktop 1440x900, phone 390x844, both at 2x. Every shot needs alt text before it can be imported.

fleet-pulse.note: Set baseUrl to the hosted demo. Synthetic data, nothing to hide.

shots.alt: Fleet Pulse asset manager dashboard: revenue earned and lost by site and cause, next to a map of the fleet.
shots.caption: Asset manager: is the portfolio earning what it should?

shots.alt: PV engineer dashboard with a performance-index heatmap for every site and day.
shots.caption: PV engineer: why is this site underperforming?

shots.alt: Operations dashboard with a dispatch queue ranked by revenue at stake per day.
shots.caption: Operations: what needs attention right now?

shots.alt: Executive dashboard comparing revenue and energy with a P50 budget, with a month-end forecast.
shots.caption: Executive: are we on track, and where is the risk?

shots.alt: Detail page for a single solar site, with its strings, inverters and clipping.
shots.caption: One site in detail.

shots.alt: The operations dashboard on a phone.
shots.caption: The dashboards work on a phone too.

studio-simulator.note: The /demo page is public and has no student data. Signed-in views are left out on purpose; add them only from a demo game instance.

shots.alt: Studio Simulator's public demo page, introducing the semester-long game studio simulation.
shots.caption: The public demo page.

shots.alt: The whole demo page, including the guided tour of how a week in the simulation works.
shots.caption: The guided tour walks through a week of the simulation.

shots.alt: The Studio Simulator demo page on a phone.

step-contest.note: Use a demo contest, and list real names in screenshots/redactions.local.json so they're swapped for demo names. Set vars.contestId to that contest's id.

shots.alt: Step contest home screen on a phone, listing the contests you're in.
shots.caption: Home: your contests at a glance.

shots.alt: A contest leaderboard on a phone, with step totals, streaks and the gap to the person above.
shots.caption: The leaderboard updates the moment anyone logs.

shots.alt: Logging a day's steps on a phone: a date, a number and an optional screenshot.
shots.caption: Logging a day: two taps and a number.

shots.alt: The contest activity feed on a phone.
shots.caption: The feed keeps the group talking.

shots.alt: The contest leaderboard on a desktop screen, with the cumulative race chart.
shots.caption: On a bigger screen, the race chart shows the whole contest.

daric.note: Private household data: keep to lists, tasks and the garden. People and Weight are left out on purpose. Use redactions.local.json for any names that show.

shots.alt: Daric's home screen on a phone: a tile for each module.
shots.caption: Every part of Daric is a module with its own tile.

shots.alt: Daric's Today page on a phone, with the weather, today's tasks and reminders.
shots.caption: Today mirrors the 6am digest.

shots.alt: A shared grocery list on a phone.
shots.caption: Lists sync live between both phones.

shots.alt: Shared tasks on a phone, colour coded by who they're assigned to.
shots.caption: Tasks for either of us, or anyone.

shots.alt: The garden module on a phone, tracking crops by growth stage.
shots.caption: The garden module.

hexploration.note: Unity: capture in the editor or a build (Game view screenshot or Unity Recorder), save PNGs into screenshots/inbox/hexploration/ with these names, then write the alt text.
